description: Cancels an unpaid session: only an unexpired pending or awaiting_payment session with no detected deposit is eligible. Credentials resolve like sessions_create: the cached sk_* API key when one exists (POST /v1/sessions/:id/cancel), else a fresh dashboard JWT (POST /v1/merchants/me/sessions/:id/cancel); with neither the call fails with AUTH_REQUIRED. On success the checkout stops offering deposit instructions and a session.cancelled webhook fires. Funds that arrive afterwards are held for manual recovery and are not settled automatically; if an operator settles them, a session.completed webhook follows and carries cancelledAt, so keep tracking the order. Repeating the call returns the original outcome; a detected deposit, an expired session or a later lifecycle state answers 409. Cancellation is final: a new purchase needs a new session (and a new idempotencyKey).

mode.description: Network class. Required without exactly one cached key; never inferred from the API host.

name: sessions_cancel
title: Cancel an unpaid session
